$comment: Intended protection of main (roadmap 125.2, audit CI-2). The owners apply it
with scripts/ci/branch-protection.py --apply; --check compares it with the
live settings without changing anything (task ci:branch-protection).
required_checks is the one list of check names. A check is named after its
job (its `name:` when set, e.g. 'Terraform validate'; 'job (value)' for a
matrix). When a workflow renames or splits a job, change the name here in the
same pull request, or the old name stays required and the merge blocks.
Apply a newly added check only after a pull request run shows it green.
Squash-only merging is a repository setting, not part of this file: see
CONTRIBUTING.md and the owners' decision on merge methods.
